status: Source-qualified architectural estimates pending fresh native/cooked review.

source_frame.native_source_xy: Metres east/north in the retained normalized Jeddah frame.
source_frame.height_note: Tower height is above its estimated entrance level, not above sea level or the basement enclosure. Existing native field/contact data stay unchanged.

literal_osm.retained: Literal WGS84 nodes and way IDs are retained in sail-architecture.json and mall-architecture.json. The Sail polygon is the broad podium/site, not a tower-sized floorplate.

cvu.publisher: Council on Vertical Urbanism, The Skyscraper Center
cvu.point_note: Approximate building location, not a surveyed tower centroid.
cvu.source_history: Current property metrics differ from older CVU annual tables that listed 240 m / 64 floors. The current property-specific 264.7 m / 65 floor record is the chosen dimensional basis.

architect.observed: The architect establishes a narrow orthogonal tower perpendicular to the coastline, deep outdoor balconies that increase with height, and a lightly screened facade. Original geometry follows those cues; no old orange sail-shaped concept mass is used.
architect.epoch_and_area_conflict: The architect page lists 2018 and 646,000 square feet, while CVU lists completion in 2021 and tower GFA of 79,264 square metres. These have different reported scope/epochs. Do not silently combine them as a single measured survey.

sail_reconstruction.floorplate_basis: 1,210 square metres is within 0.8 percent of CVU tower GFA divided by 65 floors. It remains an estimated plate, not a surveyed tower footprint.
sail_reconstruction.axis_basis: Mapped southern podium frontage. The nearest retained 100 m coastline tangent gives a perpendicular axis of 20.5366 degrees; this independently supports the approximate bearing.

podium_plan_conflict.interpretation: The CVU point and coarse podium ring do not jointly provide a surveyed tower plan. Keep the anchor and bounded slab estimate, expose the small projection, and validate actual road/water separation. Do not force the entire tower into the podium ring by moving or shrinking it.

sail_reconstruction.podium: Seven estimated 4.2 m storeys in a distinct rounded northern body. A separate three-storey ballroom wing uses estimated 5.1 m pitches. Their split is original reconstruction within the mapped podium/site.
sail_reconstruction.facade: Recessed room glazing, pale horizontal slabs, staggered pale fins and glass balcony rails; balcony depth increases from 0.85 m to 1.65 m. Bay rhythm and fin pattern are original architectural estimates.
sail_reconstruction.crown: Only a small 3.5 m upper termination with a 0.7 m angled top edge. The full architectural height remains 264.7 m above the entrance.
sail_reconstruction.entry_basis: Bounded estimate from local street-class DSM samples around the site, roughly 1.7 m to 4.6 m, plus the photographed raised waterfront entrance. Not a bare-earth survey.
sail_reconstruction.foundation_basis: Separate tower and low-podium concrete enclosures extend below every actual original boundary-plane crossing. The 0.5 m bottom is an estimated below-grade closure, not a surveyed basement level. It does not set the 264.7 m tower height.
sail_reconstruction.remaining_uncertainty: Tower axis/plate, approximate map point, podium split, opening dimensions, canopy and terrace/pool positions are bounded estimates.
sail_reconstruction.occupied_height_note: CVU also lists 243.7 m to highest occupied floor. The 65 floor-band arrangement and upper 3.5 m termination are an appearance reconstruction from the primary as-built photos, not a surveyed allocation of occupied versus mechanical floors. No occupiable upper floor or mechanical plan is asserted.

architect.observed: Low retail mass with a curved highway-side glazed screen, a central glazed roof and intersecting internal roof boulevards. Actual facade photos support bowed glass, pale framing and diagonal supports. The first aerial illustration is treated as a design depiction, not a measured as-built plan.

operator_aerial.epoch: Current operator page; image capture date unverified, may include post-2017 additions. Review only.

contractor_and_designer_sources.scope_note: Three retail levels are supported. Hotel counts conflict across sources and the current office/hotel additions are not keyed to a georeferenced component plan. The operator aerial confirms two modest attached masses, not exact footprints/storey identities.

mall_reconstruction.frontage: The smooth bowed screen stays inside the retained outer envelope on the northeast/east highway frontage. It does not replace the mall with a uniformly glazed box.
mall_reconstruction.height_basis: Local street-class DSM probes are about 4.8 m to 5.4 m. The three documented retail levels include lower ground. Floor pitches and roof levels remain architectural estimates.
mall_reconstruction.dsm_classification: The 19.69 m central DSM observation is treated as roof contamination, not foundation ground. Remove old terrain only within the actual new property masks; do not flatten the wider city.
mall_reconstruction.roof: Original white/glass barrel bands, a crossing roof boulevard and low mechanical clusters follow the primary images. Their precise dimensions/locations remain estimated.
mall_reconstruction.attached_wings: Two modest seaward-side blue-glass blocks use estimated six/seven level organization. Positions and identities are not surveyed; no current Joudyan tenant branding is added.
mall_reconstruction.new_field_tip: The source footprint extends about 3 m east of the existing retained grid. That is new coverage. Its declared foundation closure uses horizontal extension of actual original edge-plane heights, not clamped DSM values called unchanged terrain.

service_road_reserve.source: Literal paths of OSM ways 1258398979, 1258398980, 1065029971 and 591058949 retained from coastal-map.osm.gz. Their widths are untagged.
service_road_reserve.reason: The first 4.2 m radial inset let the bowed glass overhang approach service centerlines to 1.10 m and a parking aisle to 1.25 m. That proposal was rejected. A 7 m inward reserve keeps the full bowed facade and support frames clear of bounded lane-width estimates. The literal outer roof/site ring remains unchanged. This is an architectural clearance estimate, not a surveyed curb or road-width claim.

preservation: All original ground outside the exact new property interiors retains its planes, normals and UVs through complete-cell emission. No global terrain cutout union changes. Native field/contact bytes, existing Diamond residency and global streaming radii remain fixed.
appearance_reference_epoch: Supplied edited reference; game/event year unverified. Primary images have different or unverified epochs.
visibility_limits: Sail is behind the T27 exit camera and cannot alone close the existing exit-skyline hold. Private mesh/range tests and later fresh cooked driving views are required.

night_material_assumptions.sources: Retained Perkins&Will as-built dusk view (sail-asbuilt-podium.png) plus supplied edited Jeddah night approach; exact capture/event years unverified.
night_material_assumptions.sail: Dark blue-gray recessed loggias and pale nonemissive slabs/fins remain dominant. Thin 35 mm warm strips occupy only the outer edge of selected staggered fins; about one in 41 room panes and a few ground lobby panels use existing WarmGlass. This reconstructs narrow architectural highlights and localized occupancy, not a claim about particular lit apartments.
night_material_assumptions.mall: Existing dark Glass remains on the curved screen, roof boulevards and attached blocks. Small recessed street-level WarmGlass storefront panels suggest occupied entries; no wholesale emissive roof or facade is added.
night_material_assumptions.preserved: Existing material recipes, global renderer, exposure, light energy and accepted assets stay unchanged. Fresh cooked night views must judge actual slab readability, glare and source-era appearance.
